What's new

- The floating toolbar no longer pushes its buttons outside the pill when the window is narrow: it folds the extra actions into the overflow menu instead.
- Same fix for every viewer - images, text and code, spreadsheets, documents, fonts and archives.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.13 - responsive dock fix. The pill width and the painted button set now come from one tier table, so narrow windows fold actions into the overflow menu instead of drawing icons past the pill (image windows around 430px used to spill crop/info outside the dock).
